summary: Prestwick controlled airspace and aerodrome traffic zone deactivated 0200-0300 during a mandatory controller break; no air traffic service.
text:
PRESTWICK CTA/CTR/ATZ DEACTIVATED. AIRSPACE REVERTS TO GLASS G.
ATS NOT AVBL DUE TO MANDATED CONTOLLER BREAK. PILOTS TRANSITING THE 
AREA ARE ADVISED TO MONITOR 129.455MHZ
